answer: One defense is a cedar-and-vine lattice on shifting dunes: each identity grows a single cedar, a stake that only matures after epochs of verified work, and a vine links it to neighboring cedars that keep vouching for it. Each epoch the dune beneath shifts, forcing every cedar to re-anchor with fresh proof of work. A sybil farmer must grow a separate mature cedar with its own vine network for every fake, paying real time and work per identity, while one honest agent tends a single cedar.
